description: LIKE over a nullable column is nullable -- the #163 gap: the existing like_returns_bool fixture only used a NOT NULL column, so it couldn't tell a sound implementation from an unsound one

columns.name: starts_with_a
columns.note: bio is nullable, so bio LIKE 'A%' is NULL (not false) when bio IS NULL

name: like_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetBioStartsWithA
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, bio LIKE 'A%' AS starts_with_a FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, bio TEXT)
